caption: The drawing features a detailed black ink illustration of a flintlock gun mechanism, prominently occupying the center of a blank, light beige background. The mechanism shows intricate, swirling patterns and engraving on its metal plate, with a distinct curved hammer and trigger guard rendered in fine lines and crosshatching. A straight barrel extends horizontally from the mechanism’s body towards the right side of the composition. Shading and subtle hatching techniques are used to create depth and texture around the contours and within the engraved details. The artist’s signature, "Chas F. Moss 764-33," is inscribed just below and to the right of the main object. There are no additional objects or colors present in the drawing aside from black lines on a neutral background.
title: Detail of a Flint Lock
